metadata.description: Open-source Capacitor and Capgo skills for AI agents. Install in Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, and other agent tools.

props.aria-label: AI Agent Skills for Capacitor Apps

blocks.text:
Open-source skills that help AI agents build better Capacitor applications with Capgo. Install them in Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, and other agent
          tools.
Use the generic installer first. Tool-specific commands below are optional.

props.aria-label: Copy generic install command
props.title: Copy generic install command

blocks.text: Install the whole Capgo skills repo once, then let the agent load the skill it needs.
Use these only when your agent tool needs its own installer. The generic command above is still the default path.
Use the Claude marketplace only when you want focused plugin groups instead of the generic skills install.

props.data-skills-copy:
claude plugin marketplace add Cap-go/capgo-skills
claude plugin install capgo-cloud@capgo-skills
props.aria-label: Copy Claude Code install command
props.title: Copy Claude Code install command

blocks.text: Use Gemini skill management only when the generic installer is not the right fit for your setup.

props.data-skills-copy:
gemini skills install https://github.com/Cap-go/capgo-skills
gemini skills list
props.aria-label: Copy Gemini CLI install command
props.title: Copy Gemini CLI install command
